verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy documents a public API that supports building a full integration, handling checkout and subscription events, and creating webhooks programmatically. A community user also relied on the API to export customers. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI, though, and many UI features (store builder, email marketing, segments, coupons, bundles, custom domains) have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of store-building, email marketing, coupons, bundles and domains, and independent hands-on confirmation of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can build and test a full API integration with Lemon Squeezy
